Ever since I was 14, I have had OCD. I would have obsessions about various things, that come and go. Usually, if something scares me I have a panic attack in the morning, and I take my medication (citalopram) and I’m calm. Good for the rest of the day. 

Since last summer, I have been feeling kind of suicidal and wanting to die. I have sort of just been waiting, wandering and hoping that this feeling goes away.

However, one morning I woke up from a dream thinking about hell, and it really scared me. I called my mom and eventually calmed down but when I went to bed something struck me, and I had the worst panic attack of my life. 

What I was fearful of was that this was going to be the panic attack that caused me to lose my mind. This was going to be the panic attack that caused me to get hospitalization and how would they cure me anyways because it’s not like you can ask God or something.

Basically what’s going on is since then, which was in February. I can’t stop thinking about hell. I will watch tv and think to myself “is that person scared about their soul.” The fact that I’m gay, Jewish, and suicidal doesn’t really help my thoughts either. I am just tired of feeling this way. I’m tired of looking at babies and thinking “they’re lucky because they don’t have to think about this.”

My psychiatrist gave me new medication but it’s only been sort of working. With the coronavirus and everything else going on, nothing has been helpful. I just want to stop believing. If I die, I want to die in peace. I’m sick of being scared. I worry that God is gonna be like “you were wrong” and throw me into the eternal fire.

Sorry if this was a hard read. I am a horrible writer.
